field.label: Group
field.help: The group's name in the directory, or its distinguished name. A user in it - or, with Nested groups, in a group inside it - has its addresses in this row's table.

field.label: Alias
field.help: The table's alias in Firewall: Aliases, for rules: uid_ and letters, digits or _, 31 characters at most. Left empty, one is made from the group's name when saved.
